summary:
伊頓EPS超預期、營收年增16.84%，電氣化與資料中心需求強勁。
• EPS 2.81美元，超越預期2.73美元，正向驚喜2.90%
• 營收74.5億美元，年增16.84%動能強勁
• AI資料中心、電網升級與電氣化推升電氣事業訂單
• 龐大積壓訂單提供未來營收能見度
ai_view:
訊號正向：16.84%營收年增搭配EPS超標，顯示電氣化與AI資料中心電力基礎建設需求結構性強勁，積壓訂單提供能見度。短中期股價受惠主題動能，但40.19倍本益比意味成長預期已大幅反映，須持續以訂單兌現支撐評價。中期關鍵在訂單出貨比與利潤率擴張。追蹤指標：電氣事業有機營收與訂單出貨比、積壓訂單規模、區段營業利潤率、資料中心相關營收佔比，以及全年EPS指引上修。

需留意：本益比40.19偏高，估值已反映成長預期；工業與住宅終端市場景氣循環風險；供應鏈與產能擴張執行壓力

summary_en:
Eaton beat EPS with 16.84% revenue growth, driven by strong electrification and data-center demand.
• EPS of $2.81 beat the $2.73 estimate, a 2.90% positive surprise
• Revenue of $7.45B grew a strong 16.84%
• AI data centers, grid upgrades, and electrification lift electrical bookings
• A large backlog provides forward revenue visibility

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: 16.84% revenue growth alongside an EPS beat shows structurally strong electrification and AI data-center power-infrastructure demand, with backlog providing visibility. Near to mid-term, the stock benefits from thematic momentum, but a 40.19x P/E means growth is largely priced in, requiring continued order conversion to support the multiple. Mid-term, book-to-bill and margin expansion are key. Track: electrical organic revenue and book-to-bill, backlog size, segment operating margins, data-center revenue mix, and full-year EPS guidance raises.

Watch：P/E of 40.19 is elevated, pricing in growth expectations; Cyclical risk in industrial and residential end markets; Supply-chain and capacity-expansion execution pressure
